title: Exactness and scalar actions of pro-etale origin operations
statement: Let O be a commutative ring and ell in O. Fix a compactification X --j--> Z --p--> Y, a strict etale compact-support package S and exceptional right adjunction G [def-sf-strict-etale-exceptional-adjoint-interfaces], actual site comparison packages CX,CY,CZ, and an actual pro-etale compact-support package P at their evaluations [def-pur-exceptional-system-transport-interfaces, def-coef-system-site-transport-interfaces]. Put F=P.derivedOpen followed by P.properDerived.system.direct, and H=CY.image.system.direct followed by G.right followed by CX.image.system.inverse. There exist additive structures and integer-shift comparison structures on F and H, and canonical coefficient scalar-action packages scalarX and scalarY, such that F and H with those structures are triangulated. For every r in O and every input, F and H carry the component of derived scalar multiplication by r to the corresponding scalar component on their output. The scalar-action packages include their ordinary levelwise scalar multiplication and localization equations; these are not arbitrary actions.

proof.text:
extension by zero is additive and exact, so localization gives its
canonical additive and shift structures and preserves distinguished triangles.
Proper direct image is its universal K-injective right-derived functor and is
triangulated. The site inverse image is exact; the site direct image is a total
right-derived functor. Compose these structures with the recorded triangulated
etale right adjoint. Multiplication by r is the ordinary natural endomorphism
whose component at level n is multiplication by the image of r in the quotient
constant ring sheaf. Its compatibility with transitions is scalar linearity.
Localize that natural transformation on complexes. On representatives each
inverse image, open extension and proper direct image commutes with this scalar;
the universal localization or right-derived property extends the identities to
all derived objects. The etale right adjoint has this property by its recorded
linearity, so the transported right composite has it as well.

lean.statement: theorem exceptionalProOriginExactLinear : ∃ (leftAdditive : (exceptionalProSupport P).Additive) (rightAdditive : (exceptionalSystemRight G CX CY).Additive) (leftShift : (exceptionalProSupport P).CommShift ℤ) (rightShift : (exceptionalSystemRight G CX CY).CommShift ℤ) (scalarX : ExceptionalProScalarAction X O ell) (scalarY : ExceptionalProScalarAction Y O ell), (@Functor.IsTriangulated _ _ _ _ _ _ (exceptionalProSupport P) leftShift _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _) ∧ (@Functor.IsTriangulated _ _ _ _ _ _ (exceptionalSystemRight G CX CY) rightShift _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _) ∧ (∀ r M, (exceptionalProSupport P).map ((scalarX.derived r).app M) = (scalarY.derived r).app ((exceptionalProSupport P).obj M)) ∧ (∀ r N, (exceptionalSystemRight G CX CY).map ((scalarY.derived r).app N) = (scalarX.derived r).app ((exceptionalSystemRight G CX CY).obj N))
